releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v6.5.3 Interactive Hot-Swap In-App Updater & UI Upgrades:
- Live Download Progress Modal: Visual percentage, download speed, and MB progress bar with cancel and browser fallback.
- Reliable Hot-Swap Engine: Robust administrator-elevated process termination, binary replacement, and instant relaunch.
- Card Header Layout: Ellipsis trimming prevents text from ever colliding with status pills.
- Battery Conservation: Active checkmark badges for 60% / 80% / 100% modes.
- Instant Battery Diagnostics: Synchronous ACPI design capacity query on launch.
